analytic_findings: Episode pooling equals off-diagonal row-normalized span-weighted clique aggregation, factored through episode sums.
For fixed membership, the pool is permutation-equivariant inside an episode, not a within-run directional chronology operator.

Two equal-width states 0 and 1 give context1 to state0. Splitting state0 into two half-width identical copies gives context2/3 to either copy. Span weighting alone does not confer leave-one-hold-out subdivision invariance.
